avis.titre: Super effective at a great price
avis.texte: You know you picked a good exfoliant when you look forward to the day of the week that you get to use it. So it is with this jar of magic. I was a user of the Goop microdermabrasion product for years but always questioned its hefty price tag. I tried this as an alternative and it is every bit as good for a fourth of the price. I use it the same way I used Goop, which is a bit different than what Mad Hippie says to do. I apply a light layer and let sit for a couple minutes, THEN buff around and rinse. Letting the acids do their thing first makes the physical step easier, and my sensitive skin prefers this order, probably because letting acid sit on newly buffed skin is harsher. Follow with a simple face oil and a cream with some dimethicone in it to protect your freshly exfoliated skin and BAM, baby soft and bright skin like you just had a facial. I will be using this for life. This product seems to take more rinsing than other similar products. Take the time to do it so you avoid irritating your skin.

Philosophy's Microdelivery 2-Step Resurfacing Peel Kit (that I bought religiously for years but gave up when I opted for cleaner / greener / eco friendly personal care) and the homemade microdermabrasion scrub that my esthetician makes for my quarterly appointments.
